# IsaPhilo Enterprise

> Building materials supplier and construction partner based at Mfuom Last Stop,
> Dunkwa-On-Offin, Central Region, Ghana. Serving contractors, homeowners and
> project teams in the Central, Western and Ashanti Regions.

## What we supply
- Cement: Ghacem, Dangote, Dzata and Diamond
- Iron rods and steel products (beams, channels, plates, mesh, binding wire)
- Roofing sheets
- Blocks and paving
- Ghana paints (emulsions and primers)
- Plywood
- POP and plasterboard ceiling systems
- Security doors

Stock, prices and specifications change. Customers should confirm current
availability, pricing and delivery with the team before ordering.

## Services
- Material supply and sales: quotations, stock and delivery options from the Mfuom hub
- Delivery: building-material dispatch from Mfuom across the service areas; timing depends on stock and destination
- Mfuom block factory: solid, hollow and interlocking blocks and paving
- Steel cut and bend: reinforcement steel preparation
- Ghana paints and colour tinting
- Building construction, and design and build for residential and commercial projects
- Masonry and block laying
- Tiles and POP ceiling installation, including Knauf board systems
- Security door installation
- Plumbing for new builds, renovations and maintenance
- Land surveying to support site planning
- Building maintenance and repairs

Customers should confirm service availability and project requirements with the team.

## Where we are
IsaPhilo Enterprise, Mfuom Last Stop, Cemetery Road, Mfuom,
Dunkwa-On-Offin, Central Region, Ghana

## Hours
Monday to Saturday, 7am to 6pm. Closed Sunday.
